\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{گروی} (girvī)}{گروی (girvī)}]{\ur{گروی} (girvī) — pawned; held as a pledge (for a loan)}

\label{lesson:UR-C540-girvi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a piece of advice, then the Urdu for to bow (one's head).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{گروی}}
\textbf{\ur{گروی}} — \emph{girvī} — \textquotedblleft{}pawned; held as a pledge (for a loan)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{قرض} \ur{نہیں} \ur{ملا} \ur{تو} \ur{گھر} \ur{گروی} \ur{رکھنا} \ur{پڑے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar qarz nahīṅ milā to ghar girvī rakhnā paṛe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If we don't get a loan, we'll have to mortgage the house.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{گروی}} (\emph{girvī}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{girav}, \textquotedblleft{}a pledge, a pawn\textquotedblright{}, with the ending \emph{-ī}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{girvī}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{girvī}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar qarz nahīṅ milā to ghar girvī rakhnā paṛe gā.} — If we don't get a loan, we'll have to mortgage the house.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for a piece of advice, then the Urdu for to bow (one's head), then say \emph{girvī} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{گروی} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Pawned; held as a pledge (for a loan)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{اخراجات} (ikhrājāt)}{اخراجات (ikhrājāt)}]{\ur{اخراجات} (ikhrājāt) — expenses}

\label{lesson:UR-C540-ikhrajat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to bow (one's head), then the Urdu for pawned.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{اخراجات}}
\textbf{\ur{اخراجات}} — \emph{ikhrājāt} — \textquotedblleft{}expenses\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{اخراجات} \ur{بڑھے} \ur{تو} \ur{ہمیں} \ur{زیادہ} \ur{کام} \ur{کرنا} \ur{پڑے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar ikhrājāt baṛhe to hameṅ zyādā kām karnā paṛe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If our expenses go up, we will have to work more.
\end{quote}

Masculine, used in the plural.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{اخراجات}} (\emph{ikhrājāt}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{ikhrājāt}, \textquotedblleft{}outgoings\textquotedblright{}, the plural of \emph{ikhrāj}, \textquotedblleft{}taking out\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ikhrājāt}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ikhrājāt}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar ikhrājāt baṛhe to hameṅ zyādā kām karnā paṛe gā.} — If our expenses go up, we will have to work more.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for to bow (one's head), then the Urdu for pawned, then say \emph{ikhrājāt} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{اخراجات} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Expenses\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{معاوضہ} (muāvazā)}{معاوضہ (muāvazā)}]{\ur{معاوضہ} (muāvazā) — compensation (for a loss or for work)}

\label{lesson:UR-C540-muavaza}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for pawned, then the Urdu for expenses.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{معاوضہ}}
\textbf{\ur{معاوضہ}} — \emph{muāvazā} — \textquotedblleft{}compensation (for a loss or for work)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{نے} \ur{یہ} \ur{کام} \ur{کیا} \ur{تو} \ur{معاوضہ} \ur{ملے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp ne yih kām kiyā to muāvazā mile gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you do this job, you will be paid for it.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{معاوضہ}} (\emph{muāvazā}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{muʿāwaḍa}, \textquotedblleft{}an exchange, a giving in return\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{muāvazā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{muāvazā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar āp ne yih kām kiyā to muāvazā mile gā.} — If you do this job, you will be paid for it.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for pawned, then the Urdu for expenses, then say \emph{muāvazā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{معاوضہ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Compensation (for a loss or for work)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{تاوان} (tāvān)}{تاوان (tāvān)}]{\ur{تاوان} (tāvān) — damages (to be paid)}

\label{lesson:UR-C540-tavan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for expenses, then the Urdu for compensation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{تاوان}}
\textbf{\ur{تاوان}} — \emph{tāvān} — \textquotedblleft{}damages (to be paid)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{بچوں} \ur{نے} \ur{کھڑکی} \ur{توڑی} \ur{تو} \ur{تاوان} \ur{دینا} \ur{پڑے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar bachchoṅ ne khiṛkī toṛī to tāvān denā paṛe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the children break the window, we'll have to pay for it.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{تاوان}} (\emph{tāvān}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{tāvān}, \textquotedblleft{}a fine, compensation for loss\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tāvān}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar bachchoṅ ne khiṛkī toṛī to tāvān denā paṛe gā.} — If the children break the window, we'll have to pay for it.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for expenses, then the Urdu for compensation, then say \emph{tāvān} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{لٹنا} (luṭnā)}{لٹنا (luṭnā)}]{\ur{لٹنا} (luṭnā) — to be robbed; to be ruined}

\label{lesson:UR-C540-lutna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for compensation, then the Urdu for damages (to be paid).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{لٹنا}}
\textbf{\ur{لٹنا}} — \emph{luṭnā} — \textquotedblleft{}to be robbed; to be ruined\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{نے} \ur{جوا} \ur{کھیلا} \ur{تو} \ur{آپ} \ur{لٹ} \ur{جائیں} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp ne juā khelā to āp luṭ jāeṅ ge.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you gamble, you will be fleeced.
\end{quote}

Past (he …): \ur{وہ} \ur{سفر} \ur{میں} \ur{لٹ} \ur{گیا}, \emph{voh safar meṅ luṭ gayā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{لٹنا}} (\emph{luṭnā}) is the intransitive partner of \emph{lūṭnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to plunder\textquotedblright{}, which CDIAL lists under \emph{*luṭṭati}, a form it reconstructs (CDIAL 11078).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{luṭnā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{luṭnā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar āp ne juā khelā to āp luṭ jāeṅ ge.} — If you gamble, you will be fleeced.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for compensation, then the Urdu for damages (to be paid), then say \emph{luṭnā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{لٹنا} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To be robbed; to be ruined\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from On the Board to Weighing the Cost}

\label{lesson:UR-R540-review-534-540}



\begin{quote}
Say the Urdu for a game board and a piece (in a board game).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a game board, a piece (in a board game), a pawn, checkmate, ludo
  \item an omen, ill-omened, a magic spell, an astrologer, a horoscope
  \item cautious, alert, a warning, cover (to shelter behind), an emergency
  \item an alternative, alike, something in exchange (for), a touchstone, to select
  \item indecision, hesitant, a hunch, to totter, unshakable
  \item force, free to decide, unavoidable, a piece of advice, to bow (one's head)
  \item pawned, expenses, compensation, damages (to be paid), to be robbed
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A game board? (\textbf{\ur{بساط}}, \emph{bisāt}.) A piece (in a board game)? (\textbf{\ur{مہرہ}}, \emph{mohrā}.) A pawn? (\textbf{\ur{پیادہ}}, \emph{piyādā}.) Checkmate? (\textbf{\ur{مات}}, \emph{māt}.) Ludo? (\textbf{\ur{لوڈو}}, \emph{luḍo}.) An omen? (\textbf{\ur{شگون}}, \emph{shagun}.) Ill-omened? (\textbf{\ur{منحوس}}, \emph{manhūs}.) A magic spell? (\textbf{\ur{ٹونا}}, \emph{ṭonā}.) An astrologer? (\textbf{\ur{نجومی}}, \emph{najūmī}.) A horoscope? (\textbf{\ur{زائچہ}}, \emph{zāichā}.) Cautious? (\textbf{\ur{محتاط}}, \emph{mohtāt}.) Alert? (\textbf{\ur{چوکنا}}, \emph{chaukannā}.) A warning? (\textbf{\ur{انتباہ}}, \emph{intibāh}.) Cover (to shelter behind)? (\textbf{\ur{آڑ}}, \emph{āṛ}.) An emergency? (\textbf{\ur{ایمرجنسی}}, \emph{emarjansī}.) An alternative? (\textbf{\ur{متبادل}}, \emph{mutabādil}.) Alike? (\textbf{\ur{یکساں}}, \emph{yaksāṅ}.) Something in exchange (for)? (\textbf{\ur{عوض}}, \emph{evaz}.) A touchstone? (\textbf{\ur{کسوٹی}}, \emph{kasauṭī}.) To select? (\textbf{\ur{منتخب} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{muntakhab karnā}.) Indecision? (\textbf{\ur{تذبذب}}, \emph{tazabzub}.) Hesitant? (\textbf{\ur{متردد}}, \emph{mutaraddid}.) A hunch? (\textbf{\ur{گمان}}, \emph{gumān}.) To totter? (\textbf{\ur{ڈگمگانا}}, \emph{ḍagmagānā}.) Unshakable? (\textbf{\ur{اٹل}}, \emph{aṭal}.) Force? (\textbf{\ur{زبردستی}}, \emph{zabardastī}.) Free to decide? (\textbf{\ur{مختار}}, \emph{mukhtār}.) Unavoidable? (\textbf{\ur{ناگزیر}}, \emph{nāguzīr}.) A piece of advice? (\textbf{\ur{صلاح}}, \emph{salāh}.) To bow (one's head)? (\textbf{\ur{جھکانا}}, \emph{jhukānā}.) Pawned? (\textbf{\ur{گروی}}, \emph{girvī}.) Expenses? (\textbf{\ur{اخراجات}}, \emph{ikhrājāt}.) Compensation? (\textbf{\ur{معاوضہ}}, \emph{muāvazā}.) Damages (to be paid)? (\textbf{\ur{تاوان}}, \emph{tāvān}.) To be robbed? (\textbf{\ur{لٹنا}}, \emph{luṭnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
